title: Exact Pre-Measurement Bipartite Purity and Renyi-2 Entanglement Across the Survivor-Syndrome Cut
claims: Prior to measuring the (h-1) syndrome wires of a weight-h CNOT witness tree, the reduced survivor state has exact purity Tr(rho_surv(s)^2) = 0.5 * (1 + prod_{r=1}^{h-1} cos^2(2*pi <A_{.,r}, s> / q)).

The survivor-syndrome cut is separable (S_2 = 0) iff 2 <A_{.,r}, s> == 0 (mod q) for all r >= 1, and maximally Bell-entangled (S_2 = 1 bit) iff at least one syndrome wire sits at a quarter-period cos(2*pi <A_{.,r}, s> / q) = 0.
favorable_controls: Maximal Bell control phases=[1,2,3] mod 8 (purity=0.5, S_2=1.0 bit)
